cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(mixed C)
enable_testing()
add_custom_command(OUTPUT gen.c COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/gen.c.in gen.c DEPENDS src/gen.c.in)
add_library(base STATIC src/base.c)
add_library(objs OBJECT src/obj.c)
add_library(genlib STATIC gen.c)
target_link_libraries(genlib base)
add_executable(app src/app.c $<TARGET_OBJECTS:objs>)
target_link_libraries(app base)
add_executable(t_gen tests/t_gen.c)
target_link_libraries(t_gen genlib)
add_executable(t_base tests/t_base.c)
target_link_libraries(t_base base)
add_executable(t_obj tests/t_obj.c $<TARGET_OBJECTS:objs>)
add_test(NAME gen_ok COMMAND t_gen)
add_test(NAME base_ok COMMAND t_base)
add_test(NAME obj_ok COMMAND t_obj)
set_tests_properties(base_ok PROPERTIES LABELS "unit")
